text:
lia: FYI we're getting a burst of `parse_error` alerts for SSE routes after last night's proxy coalescer rollout. customers report truncated JSON messages inside events. console parse_error_rate jumped ~300% at 02:12 UTC.
omar: saw that. kernel logs show the proxy coalesced small TCP segments which changed event chunk boundaries. our SSE fan-out assumes event-per-chunk in a downstream optimization, so boundary changes break the simple parser.
kevin: ouch. do we have repro?
lia: yes — manual repro using netcat to send small pieces with sleeps. gist:
```
echo -n "data:{\"id\":1, \"text\":" > /tmp/p1
sleep 0.1
echo -n " \"hello\"}\n\n" > /tmp/p2
cat /tmp/p1 /tmp/p2 | nc -l 5555
# client connects -> sometimes sees incomplete JSON depending on proxy coalescing
```
maria: patch on proxy was intended to reduce syscalls by merging segments. good for perf but this is a behavioral change for streaming parsers.
ingest-bot: alert: route=public-stream parse_error_count=124 (+320%) window=5m
kevin: short-term mitigation ideas: (A) revert coalescer for streaming-enabled routes (B) adjust our SSE parser to be boundary-agnostic and buffer until a double-newline, (C) add a server-side header `X-Raw-Chunked: true` to indicate chunk semantics.
omar: (B) is the right long-term fix. parser should not rely on socket chunking. quick patch could be a small stateful buffer until event delimiter `\n\n` is seen.
maria: UX/telemetry ask: console should show `raw_chunk_rate` and `parse_error_rate` side-by-side with an annotation when proxy coalescer rollout happened. ops needs to correlate spikes with infra rollouts.
console-bot: opened ticket #ENG-2011 "SSE parser buffering + dashboard chunking telemetry" assigned eng-platform + eng-runtime.
sre-bot: note: rollout 2026-03-19 proxy/coalescer v2 applied to edge pool-3 at 02:05 UTC. correlated with start of spike.
kevin: plan: Omar to PR a minimal buffering fallback for SSE parser (buffer until event delimiter) and feature-flag it; Maria to request a temporary route-level override to disable coalescer for high-volume streaming routes; Lia to assemble a repro case and customer-impact list. If buffering patch looks safe we'll fast-track.
omar: starting PR now. will add unit tests for split-chunk events.
lia: after we land the buffer-flag I'll replay the repro against canary and post results.
maria: also add a console note in the rollout timeline so oncall sees the linkage without digging into infra tickets.
kevin: +1. thanks team.
